[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369464/0e311288105403d9db573c633abd26ed31686a8b.png[/img]

[h2]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration Event[/h2]

[b]Ouros[/b] will be on sale for the [b]Wholesome Game Steam Celebration[/b] from [b]August 15th[/b] to [b]21st[/b]. Check it out, as well as all the other wholesome games part of the event!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Click here for the Wholesome Games Steam Event[/url]. The event starts on August 15th, 1pm ET.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369464/874139cf321e0b14ec819f24bb1a6df5d2e8eb1a.png[/img]

[h2]PlayNYC x AnimeNYC[/h2]

I'll also be﻿ exhibiting [b]Ouros[/b] at [b]PlayNYC[/b] from [b]August 23rd[/b] to [b]25th[/b]. This year, PlayNYC is partnering with [b]AnimeNYC[/b] to host the event. If you are in NYC and attending this convention, say hello and check out my booth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369464/9b0e8374b6ec4fb7a7820a4548c161685d3a8af2.png[/img]

[h2]Back to School Games Celebration - Steam Event[/h2]

Lastly, Ouros will be on sale for the [b]Back to School Games Celebration[/b] on Steam from [b]August 26th[/b] to [b]September 1st[/b]! Expect some games that are educational, productivity-enhancing, and help enrich your mind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369464/bca1d49df623d10e265c604b066e0a89070035a1.png[/img]

---

That's all for now! I'm super excited for all of these events, thank you so much to everyone for all the support!

Best,
Michael

notes.title: Steam Deck Support!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce that Ouros works great on Steam Deck! I've been working hard on getting it to work seamlessly, and am very happy with how it controls. You'll be able to play on Steam Deck in 3 different ways:
[olist]
[*] Ouros will have [b]multi-touch support[/b] for Steam Deck. Multi-Touch works especially well on the new Steam Deck OLED!
[*] You'll be to use the [b]Right Trackpad[/b] to emulate the mouse cursor (click and drag with trackpad click or R2).
[*] You'll also be able to use the [b]Left Joystick[/b] to emulate the mouse cursor (click and drag with the A button).[/olist]

You can even combine control schemes! For example you can use the right trackpad to drag one point, and use touch to drag another.

Here's a video of multi-touch!
[previewyoutube=I6FVM8dWrG4;full][/previewyoutube]

The UI functions with the touch, mouse cursor emulation, and dpad+buttons.

Ouros runs at a buttery smooth 90 fps on the new Steam Deck OLED model, and 60 fps on the older LCD model.

If playing on the Steam Deck, be sure to use the Official Controller Layout.


That's all for now! Be sure to wishlist Ouros if you haven't already! I can't wait it into your hands.

Best,
Michael
